title: Lightly Buttery Thai Rice Khao Pad
description: A buttery and flaky Thai dish featuring soured cream and chive dip, made with lamination-puff and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, in the form of khao-pad.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Brush the pastry with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Spread the cooled jasmine rice over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border on either side.
Dot the top of the rice with the unsalted butter.
Fold the pastry over the rice, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the top of the pastry with the remaining egg and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the khao-pad in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
While the khao-pad is baking, mix the soured cream and chopped chives in a small bowl.
Serve the khao-pad hot with the soured cream and chive dip.
